validated_results.title: Dietary risk factors for renal cell carcinoma in Denmark.
validated_results.reason: Population-based case-control study in Denmark reporting odds ratios for dairy products (butter spread, whole milk) and incident histologically verified renal cell carcinoma.

extraction.comparison_type: Women using thickly spread butter compared to thinly spread

sample_size.excerpt: A total of 351 cases (73% of the eligible) and 340 controls (68% of the eligible) were included in the study.
sample_size.location: abstract; total_n derived from reported group counts 351 + 340 = 691

cases.excerpt: A total of 351 cases (73% of the eligible) and 340 controls (68% of the eligible) were included in the study.

effect_size.excerpt: Dairy products may be associated with risk of renal cell cancer (OR for women using thickly spread butter compared to thinly spread: 11.4 (95% CI 2.8-45), OR for women who drank more than one glass of milk with 3.5% fat content compared to never drink milk: 3.7 (95% CI 1.2-11).

confidence_interval.excerpt: Dairy products may be associated with risk of renal cell cancer (OR for women using thickly spread butter compared to thinly spread: 11.4 (95% CI 2.8-45), OR for women who drank more than one glass of milk with 3.5% fat content compared to never drink milk: 3.7 (95% CI 1.2-11).
